name: paper_with_source_data_and_word_report
prompt: Use evomind-paper-scan to review a paper with a supplementary source-data folder and generate a Word internal report.
expected_behaviors: reads the whole paper before judging data
runs or inspects numeric scan outputs
uses the concise data audit component label paperconan v0.5.0
generates EvoMind-branded Markdown and DOCX reports

name: paper_without_source_data
prompt: Use evomind-paper-scan to review a PDF where no source data is provided.
expected_behaviors: does not infer fabrication from missing data alone

name: scanner_false_positive
prompt: Use evomind-paper-scan on a paper where paperconan flags questionnaire Likert coding tables.
expected_behaviors: maps scanner findings to the appendix questionnaire
downgrades expected ordinal coding patterns as plausible benign explanations
does not call the data fabricated
